templates.description: Search the codebase for recent changes, analyzing git history and file modifications to understand what has changed.
templates.name: Search for Recent Changes

tasks.description: Get list of recent commits with summary
Get list of files that have been modified

prompt.template:
Get the list of files changed in recent commits.

Based on the commits found, use git diff --stat or git log --name-only to list modified files.

tasks.description: Analyze the nature of changes and create a summary

prompt.template:
Analyze the changes found and create a summary.

Commits found:
{{task.list-recent-commits.output}}

Files changed:
{{task.get-changed-files.output}}

Provide:
1. Overview of what changed
2. Key areas affected
3. Any notable patterns (e.g., many changes to one area)
4. Potential areas of concern

tasks.description: Get detailed diff for significant changes (optional, based on analysis)

prompt.template:
Based on the analysis, get detailed diffs for the most significant changes.

Focus on files that seem most important based on the analysis. Use git diff or git show to get actual code changes.
